title: Power bound for the least prime
statement: For every natural number $n$, let $p_n$ be the least prime number greater than or equal to $2^{\lceil\log_2(2n)\rceil}+1$, with the ceiling taken in the natural-number convention. Then $2^{\lceil\log_2(2n)\rceil} < p_n$.
